text:
{ "entries": [
  {
    "name_han": "龍虎手鑑圖",
    "logic_thesis": "The chart proves that dragon-tiger union is not a mythic image but a measurable sequence of qi phases: when lead and mercury, fire and water, are timed correctly, their mutual conquest becomes mutual generation. It demonstrates that failure in neidan is almost always a timing error, not a substance error—wrong fire at the wrong hour dissolves the elixir that correct sequencing would have fixed.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Dragon (mercury/spirit) and tiger (lead/body) circulate in opposite directions within the same vessel. 2. If they meet under unbalanced fire, they clash and scatter. 3. Therefore the chart maps clock-hours, hexagram lines, and organ channels as a single coordinate system. 4. Inference: correct positioning of fire (wen/wu) forces opposition into conjunction. 5. Conclusion: the elixir is produced by phase-locked opposition, not by adding more substance. 6. Corollary: any method that ignores the hand-mirror coordinates is practicing aspiration, not alchemy.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Map your daymaster’s yin-yang and five-element polarity onto dragon (yin spirit) vs tiger (yang essence). 2. Time major fire phases only when chart markers say the two streams are approaching conjunction (e.g., zi-wu axis, seasonal pivots). 3. Use the diagram’s organ/channel labels to locate where clash will appear as illness or emotional surge. 4. In cultivation sessions, reverse the usual order when the chart shows inverted flow—do not force standard sequence. 5. Treat every failed session as a clock/phase error first, substance second.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike plain “lead-mercury” verse texts, this work argues by spatial diagram: proof is geometric, not poetic. It differs from later *Wuzhen pian* style metaphor by making timing coordinates primary and moral language secondary—because the claim is operational success, not doctrinal orthodoxy."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "三才定位圖",
    "logic_thesis": "The chart proves that Heaven, Earth, and Human are not three separate realms but three interlocking position-functions: each only has meaning when fixed relative to the other two. Destiny (ming) is therefore a positioning problem—misplaced human agency relative to celestial pattern and terrestrial response produces friction that looks like fate.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Heaven supplies pattern (li/qi timing), Earth supplies form/place, Human supplies intentional action. 2. If Human acts without locating itself in Heaven’s time and Earth’s place, action becomes noise. 3. The chart assigns fixed coordinates so that “position” is legible. 4. Inference: correct siting of the self in the triad converts random events into usable feedback. 5. Conclusion: cultivation and BaZi reading both fail when they treat only one cai (e.g., only natal chart or only landscape) as complete. 6. Therefore alignment of three positions is the minimal unit of real efficacy.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Always read a BaZi chart with year/month (Heaven), day/hour and body (Human), and dwelling/seasonal locale (Earth) as one system. 2. When luck pillars clash, check which of the three positions moved—not only which stem changed. 3. In meditation, seat the mind (Human) between crown/sky awareness and perineum/earth root before circulating qi. 4. For decisions, ask: is this the right time (天), right place/resource (地), right agent posture (人)? 5. Correct one misaligned position before adding more techniques.",
    "logic_compare": "Compared with abstract cosmologies that only praise the triad, this text insists on *dingwei*—fixed coordinates—so that theory can be checked. It differs from pure fengshui or pure astrology texts by refusing any single-cai monopoly: the argument is structural interdependence, not specialty technique."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "上清洞真九宮紫房圖",
    "logic_thesis": "The diagram proves that the inner cosmos is a nine-palace architecture: spirit does not float freely but occupies, visits, and is governed by discrete chambers, with the Purple Chamber as the command node. Immortality practice is therefore palace-governance—knowing which palace holds which spirit and how to enter without disorder—rather than formless quietism.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Shangqing maps the body as a celestial court of nine palaces. 2. Each palace hosts named spirits with ranks and functions. 3. The Purple Chamber (zǐfáng) is the pivotal residence for higher spirit-light. 4. Inference: visualization and breath must follow palace topology or the spirits scatter. 5. Conclusion: attainment is orderly visitation and stabilization in the Purple Chamber, not mere emptiness. 6. Disorder of palace sequence explains possession-like symptoms and failed ascent.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Learn the nine-palace grid (including central) as an inner map before advanced visualization. 2. Stabilize lower and peripheral palaces first; do not force Purple Chamber entry under agitation. 3. In BaZi/medical reading, map nine-palace imbalance to organ-spirit symptoms (shen disturbance vs jing depletion). 4. Use calendar/hourly timing consistent with Shangqing visitation logic for major workings. 5. Treat “seeing lights” without palace order as leakage, not success.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike Zhong-Lü or later golden-elixir charts focused on fire phases and lower dantian, this Shangqing chart prioritizes hierarchical spirit residences. It differs from purely cosmological *luoshu* nine-palace uses by making the Purple Chamber a *somatic-theological* throne, not only a number square."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "道德真經解",
    "logic_thesis": "A true *jie* (explication) of the *Daodejing* proves that Laozi’s paradoxes are causal laws of soft power: non-contention, emptiness, and return are mechanisms that reliably outlast force. The text argues that misreading Dao as mystical license produces either quietist collapse or legalist hardness—both violations of the same soft-over-hard causality.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Dao operates by reversal and low-positioning. 2. Hard methods generate equal and opposite resistance. 3. Soft methods absorb resistance and redirect it. 4. Inference: governing body or state by force shortens life; governing by emptiness lengthens capacity. 5. Conclusion: “wuwei” is optimal control under reverse-causality, not inactivity. 6. Therefore commentary must translate paradox into operable soft strategy.",
    "logic_practice": "1. In BaZi, when a chart is over-controlled, prefer unblocking and circulating over aggressive suppression of “bad” elements. 2. In cultivation, reduce forced breathing/fire when signs of resistance (agitation, heat, insomnia) appear. 3. Apply “lower position” socially and energetically: yield timing to seasonal qi. 4. Use return-to-root practices (evening, winter, yin hours) as primary strategy, not emergency fix. 5. Judge techniques by whether they increase capacity without backlash.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike purely philological commentaries, a *zhenjing jie* of this type claims practical causality. It differs from alchemical *Daodejing* readings that force every line into lead-mercury symbolism: here the proof structure is political-body isomorphism under soft law, not laboratory metaphor alone."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "道德真經三解",
    "logic_thesis": "Triple explication proves that one Dao-text yields three valid layers of truth—typically cosmic, political/ethical, and somatic-alchemical—and that restricting the text to one layer is a category error. The argument is that contradiction between readings dissolves when each is assigned its proper domain rather than forced into a single allegory.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: The *Daodejing* is polysemic by design. 2. Layer A explains Heaven’s pattern; Layer B explains human order; Layer C explains body-as-kingdom. 3. Cross-layer identity of structure (softness, return, simplicity) validates all three. 4. Inference: a single-layer school will either moralize alchemy away or privatize politics into the body wrongly. 5. Conclusion: “three solutions” is a method of complete reading, not indecision. 6. Practical wisdom is choosing which layer to operationalize for the problem at hand.",
    "logic_practice": "1. When reading a verse, explicitly tag which of the three layers you are using before applying it. 2. For BaZi counseling, use political/ethical layer for life strategy and somatic layer for health timing. 3. For neidan, translate “soft/weak” into fire control and nervous-system downregulation. 4. Resolve apparent contradictions by reassigning layer, not by discarding the text. 5. Teach students one layer at a time to avoid mixed metaphors that break practice.",
    "logic_compare": "It differs from single-school *Daodejing* commentaries (pure Xuanxue, pure politics, pure neidan) by institutionalizing multi-valence as the thesis. Compared with *道德真經解*, the distinctive claim is methodological: thrice-solved completeness, not one master key."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "道德玄經原旨",
    "logic_thesis": "The work proves that the “original aim” (*yuanzhi*) of the mysterious classic is a single generative principle—Dao as prior, subtle, and productive—against later scholastic overlays that multiply concepts until the root is lost. Restoration of meaning is therefore subtractive: recover the aim, and secondary doctrines reorganize themselves.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Later commentaries accrete jargon that obscures Laozi’s root aim. 2. The root aim is the generative priority of the Mystery (xuan). 3. If practice starts from branches (techniques, names, ranks), it cannot return to root. 4. Inference: authentic reading must reconstruct *yuanzhi* before technique. 5. Conclusion: doctrinal purity is measured by fidelity to generative simplicity, not by number of authorities cited. 6. Thus “original aim” is a critical filter for all later Daoist systems.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Before complex neidan schedules, restate the aim in one sentence: return to the subtle generative source. 2. Cull practices that increase stimulation without increasing stillness-capacity. 3. In BaZi, prefer readings that restore the chart’s generative cycle over endless god-kill lists. 4. Use “xuan” as a check: does this step make the process more subtle or more theatrical? 5. Periodically reset to breath, posture, and honest observation as root.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike encyclopedic compilations, this text’s logic is restorative minimalism. It differs from *三解* pluralism by arguing for a recoverable single *aim* beneath layers—layers are allowed only after the root is secured."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "玄經原旨發揮",
    "logic_thesis": "As an “elaboration” (*fāhūi*) of the original aim, it proves that true development of a root thesis expands applications without changing the generative center. Extension is valid only when each new domain (cosmology, ethics, alchemy) still reduces to the same *yuanzhi*; otherwise it is drift, not elaboration.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: *原旨* established the root. 2. Elaboration applies root to wider cases. 3. Valid elaboration preserves invariant structure under new variables. 4. Inference: if a new teaching cannot be derived from the root, it is foreign graft. 5. Conclusion: *fāhūi* is disciplined expansion, not free creativity. 6. Readers must test each chapter by reduction to the original aim.",
    "logic_practice": "1. When adding a new BaZi technique, reduce it to the same generative logic you accepted as root—or discard it. 2. Expand cultivation from quiet sitting to movement, sleep, and speech only if the same return-to-subtle holds. 3. Write short “reduction notes”: how does this advanced method collapse to the root aim? 4. Use elaboration periods (study) and contraction periods (pure practice) in cycles. 5. Teach advanced students to audit lineage claims by reduction test.",
    "logic_compare": "It is the necessary counterpart to *道德玄經原旨*: where *原旨* subtracts, *發揮* carefully multiplies. It differs from loose “commentary collections” by making derivability from a fixed center the criterion of truth."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "道德真經藏室纂微篇",
    "logic_thesis": "By “assembling the subtle” from the treasury chamber, the text proves that micro-structure—particle-like meanings in particles of the classic—carries the real operative power, while grand slogans do not. Depth is not more text but finer resolution: the Dao hides in *wei* (the minute), so practice must train perception of the almost-imperceptible turn.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: The classic’s power is stored in subtle turns of phrasing and qi. 2. Macro readings miss the lever points. 3. Assembling micro-commentaries recovers those levers. 4. Inference: cultivation succeeds at the moment of minute inversion (softening, yielding, returning). 5. Conclusion: “zuanwei” is a method of precision engineering of meaning and practice. 6. Coarse force is evidence one has not found the subtle hinge.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Train to notice the first second of emotional/qi turn, not the full storm. 2. In fire-phasing, adjust at the micro-sign (pulse, saliva, warmth), not after overheating. 3. In BaZi, privilege small seasonal and hourly shifts that flip usefulness of a god. 4. Annotate classics at phrase-level hinges (“故”, “若”, “反”) as operational switches. 5. Prefer one precise correction over a stack of gross techniques.",
    "logic_compare": "Compared with broad *jie* and *sanjie*, this work’s logic is micro-analytic. It differs from *原旨*’s subtractive root-seeking by zooming into granularity: both fight scholastic noise, but one by root restoration, the other by subtle assembly."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "悟玄篇",
    "logic_thesis": "The treatise proves that “awakening to the Mystery” is a discrete epistemic event—recognition of the non-dual generative source—after which techniques reorganize, rather than a gradual pile of merits alone. Without *wu* (awakening), practice remains mechanical; with it, the same methods become transparent instruments.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Xuan is not an object among objects. 2. Ordinary mind reifies techniques and results. 3. Awakening is seeing through reification to the source-process. 4. Inference: post-awakening practice is lighter, more precise, less anxious. 5. Conclusion: the text’s aim is to trigger and stabilize that recognition. 6. Mere doctrinal assent is not *wu*; embodied certainty is.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Alternate study with periods of non-seeking sitting to allow recognition, not only accumulation. 2. After any insight, immediately test it in breath and conduct—insight without embodiment fades. 3. In BaZi work, notice when you stop “fixing the chart” and start seeing one process—use that as analog of *wu*. 4. Drop methods that reinforce spiritual materialism after the turn. 5. Keep a short record of conditions that preceded genuine clarity (sleep, season, hexagram day).",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike step-by-step fire-phase manuals, *悟玄篇* centers the threshold of understanding. It differs from pure *Daodejing* commentary by being experiential-transformational: the proof is a change of knowing, not only correct exegesis."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "原陽子法語",
    "logic_thesis": "Recorded sayings of Yuanyangzi prove that authentic teaching is situational speech (*fayu*) calibrated to the student’s blockage, not a closed system of universal formulas. Authority comes from demonstrated yang-return (vital restoration) and verbal precision that cuts a specific delusion at a time.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Students fail for different reasons. 2. Fixed scripts cannot hit every blockage. 3. A realized teacher’s speech is medicine matched to disease. 4. Inference: the *法语* form preserves living calibration better than treatises. 5. Conclusion: readers must extract principles of diagnosis, not memorize answers as one-size-fits-all. 6. True yang is verified in effect, not in eloquence alone.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Diagnose the main blockage (scattered shen, depleted jing, chaotic yi) before prescribing method. 2. Use short, targeted instructions rather than full curriculum dumps. 3. In BaZi counseling, speak to the person’s actual season of life, not generic lucky elements. 4. Verify teaching by physiological and behavioral change within a defined window. 5. Revisit sayings as case-law: match new cases to analogous old ones carefully.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike systematic scriptures, *法语* logic is clinical and occasional. It differs from anonymous classic commentaries by tying truth to a named practitioner’s corrective speech—closer to Chan yulu method than to cosmological treatise."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "金丹直指",
    "logic_thesis": "“Direct pointing” proves that the golden elixir is an immediately indicable process in the body-mind—already structured by nature—obscured mainly by conceptual detours. The argument is anti-scholastic: if pointing is truly direct, lengthy outer metaphors are scaffolding to be kicked away once the real lead and mercury are recognized in situ.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: The elixir’s components are present in ordinary psycho-physical life. 2. Misdirection comes from chasing external or overly ornate maps. 3. Direct pointing names the real referents without delay. 4. Inference: recognition precedes elaborate sequencing. 5. Conclusion: orthopraxy is verified by direct experience of conjunction, not by literary completeness. 6. Obscurity that cannot be pointed to is not esoteric depth but failure of teaching.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Identify what your tradition means by lead/mercury in immediate sensation and attention—not only in symbols. 2. Run short sessions aiming at recognition of the turn, then lengthen. 3. Strip one layer of metaphor per month without losing the operational steps that still work. 4. In BaZi terms, “direct point” the chart’s true power god without drowning in every secondary star. 5. Use teacher or text only until self-verification is stable, then prioritize embodiment.",
    "logic_compare": "Contrasts with diagram-heavy works (龍虎手鑑圖, 九宮紫房圖) that prove via maps; here proof is via pointer efficiency. Differs from collected sayings by claiming a single direct object (jindan) rather than case-by-case medicine."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "群仙要語纂集",
    "logic_thesis": "By compiling essential sayings of many immortals, the text proves that consensus across lineages is a filter for reliability: what independent realized voices repeat is more likely operative than idiosyncratic flourishes. Anthology becomes an epistemological tool—cross-witness verification of the path.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Single-lineage texts may encode local bias. 2. Multiple immortals independently emphasize certain invariants (jing-qi-shen, timing, virtue, non-forcing). 3. Compilation surfaces the intersection set. 4. Inference: practitioners should weight intersection more than rare outliers. 5. Conclusion: “essential speech” is defined by repeated efficacy claims across sources. 6. Diversity without synthesis is noise; synthesis without diversity is dogma.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Extract the repeated maxims (e.g., guard jing, regulate fire, align with season) as non-negotiable baseline. 2. Treat unique techniques as optional experiments after baseline is solid. 3. When BaZi schools conflict, prefer advice that multiple classical sources support. 4. Build a personal “intersection checklist” from the anthology for daily practice audit. 5. Use outliers only when your chart/condition matches the special case they address.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike single-author *直指* or *法語*, its logic is statistical orthodoxy via anthology. It differs from *諸真內丹集要* mainly in emphasis on *speech* (maxims) rather than necessarily full method blocks—portable principles over complete protocols."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "諸真內丹集要",
    "logic_thesis": "Collecting the essentials of many perfected ones’ inner alchemy proves that neidan is a family of intertranslatable methods with a shared success condition (elixir formation / return of yang), not a single monopoly recipe. The anthology argues for comparative essentials: strip each school to its must-do core and the cores converge.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Many perfected left methods that look different. 2. Surface differences hide shared essentials (vessel, fire, coupling, timing, virtue). 3. Collecting *jiyao* isolates those essentials. 4. Inference: a practitioner can switch forms without abandoning the path if essentials remain. 5. Conclusion: orthodoxy is success-condition fidelity, not brand loyalty. 6. Incomplete collections that omit ethics or timing falsify the essentials.",
    "logic_practice": "1. For each method you study, write its 5 essentials; compare across methods for intersection. 2. Keep one primary method for 100 days; use anthology only to clarify essentials, not to mix randomly. 3. Map BaZi weak points (e.g., weak metal/water) onto which essential needs extra care (condensation vs firing). 4. Drop ornamental steps that no perfected source treats as essential. 5. Re-enter the collection when plateaued—to find a missing essential, not a novelty high.",
    "logic_compare": "More method-complete than *群仙要語纂集*; more plural than *金丹直指*. It differs from Shangqing palace scriptures by staying in the neidan success grammar (elixir) rather than visionary ascent courts."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "消搖墟經",
    "logic_thesis": "The scripture proves that free-and-easy wandering (*xiaoyao*) is not escapism but a cultivated mode of moving through ruined or empty places (*xu*) without snagging—psychologically and cosmologically. Liberation is demonstrated as frictionless passage through transformation and decay, not as denial of the world’s desolation.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: All forms trend toward ruin and emptiness. 2. Clinging to form multiplies suffering and blocks spirit travel. 3. Training in *xiaoyao* aligns the mind with transformation itself. 4. Inference: the “ruins” are the true practice field—impermanence as path. 5. Conclusion: transcendence is lightness in passage, not permanent fortress-building. 6. Cultivation that only builds denser identity fails the classic’s test.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Practice non-grasping when luck pillars shift—treat change as terrain, not insult. 2. Schedule regular “empty” sessions with no goal beyond unobstructed awareness. 3. Use decay seasons (late autumn/winter, chart resource droughts) as special training for lightness. 4. In daily life, rehearse entering chaotic social “ruins” without losing center. 5. Pair xiaoyao mind with ethical non-harm so freedom does not become callousness.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike neidan anthologies aimed at forging an elixir body, this classic’s logic is Zhuangzian mobility through emptiness. It differs from disciplinary codes (*明科*) by valuing unforced roaming over ranked observance—freedom as proof, not rank as proof."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "上清黃氣陽精三道順行經",
    "logic_thesis": "The scripture proves that yellow qi and yang essence perfect the adept only when moved along three paths in *compliant order* (*shunxing*)—forced or reversed sequencing corrupts the same substances that orderly circulation would refine. Ascent is hydraulic and calendrical: right stuff, wrong path order, still fails.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Yellow qi and yang essence are real operative substances in Shangqing physiology. 2. Three paths (courses) exist for their movement. 3. “Shun” means with the cosmic/seasonal grain. 4. Inference: reversing order produces blockage or false fire. 5. Conclusion: method fidelity is path-order fidelity. 6. Timing markers exist to know when each path is open.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Learn the three paths’ sequence before intensive essence work. 2. Align major practice blocks with solar terms that support *shun* flow. 3. If heat rises without clarity, assume path-order error—reset to earlier stage. 4. In BaZi, avoid “reversing” a weak chart with extreme remedies out of phase; prefer compliant strengthening. 5. Log path, time, and result to empirically confirm *shun* vs *ni* outcomes.",
    "logic_compare": "More operationally sequential than nine-palace spirit-court maps; more celestial-somatic than Zhong-Lü lead-mercury dualism alone. Differs from *金丹直指* by insisting on ordered multi-path circuitry rather than single direct recognition."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "太上玉珮金璫太極金書上經",
    "logic_thesis": "The upper scripture proves that talismanic tokens (jade pendant, golden bell) and Taiji golden writing are not ornaments but binding instruments that couple the adept to higher registers of order. Without authentic tokens and correct textual activation, aspiration lacks legal-spiritual jurisdiction; with them, the body is rewritten into a higher administrative cosmos.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Shangqing hierarchy is legal as well as energetic. 2. Tokens and golden books confer right of way and protection. 3. Ritual correctness activates the bond. 4. Inference: unauthorized or sloppy use fails or harms. 5. Conclusion: attainment includes receiving and embodying the text-token system. 6. Inner meaning and outer insignia co-produce legitimacy.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Treat lineage transmission and text integrity as part of practice safety, not bureaucracy. 2. Internalize pendant/bell as body centers (listening/awareness seals) if working non-liturgically. 3. Do not invent high-register invocations without preparation—jurisdiction matters. 4. In BaZi ethics, “token” analog: only claim remedies you can actually carry (resources, timing, virtue). 5. Combine symbolic implement with meditative embodiment so the token is not empty theater.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike pure neidan “no form” pointing, this classic’s logic is sacral-administrative. It differs from *明科* punitive codes by emphasizing empowering insignia and golden text, though both assume a ranked cosmos with rules."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "太真玉帝四極明科經",
    "logic_thesis": "The bright code of the Four Poles under the Jade Emperor proves that the sacred cosmos is governed by explicit law (*mingke*): merit, demerit, and ritual offense have structured consequences. Cultivation without code becomes predation on spiritual powers; code without cultivation becomes empty legality—together they stabilize the path.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Four poles structure cosmic order. 2. Clear statutes define offenses and observances. 3. Spirits and adepts are both under code. 4. Inference: progress requires purity measured by code, not only by subjective bliss. 5. Conclusion: “bright code” is transparency of cosmic justice as training environment. 6. Impunity narratives are incompatible with this system’s logic.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Adopt a short personal code (speech, sex, substances, deception) as non-negotiable for practice periods. 2. Use confession/repair rites or sincere amendment when you break it—do not “power through.” 3. In BaZi counseling, refuse techniques that harm third parties for client gain. 4. Read “Four Poles” as complete directional integrity: no hidden rotten quadrant in life. 5. Measure advancement partly by reduced need to violate your code under stress.",
    "logic_compare": "Opposite pole from *消搖墟經*’s free roaming: here freedom is fenced by luminous law. Differs from soft *Daodejing* political paradox by using positive statute and sanction rather than soft-power causality alone."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "金闕帝君三元真一經",
    "logic_thesis": "The scripture proves that the Three Primes (*sanyuan*) converge in a single True One (*zhenyi*): multiplicity of cosmic/bodily offices is real, but their perfection is unification in one sovereign awareness-body under the Golden Tower Lord. Practice that cultivates three without one fragments; one without three is empty abstraction.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Upper, middle, and lower primes structure life. 2. Each prime has agents and qi. 3. True One is their non-dual command node. 4. Inference: methods must both differentiate (train each prime) and integrate (return to one). 5. Conclusion: *sanyuan zhenyi* is the logical template for complete salvation of the person. 6. Gold Tower sovereignty symbols the achieved integration.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Train jing, qi, and shen (or three dantians) as distinct modules, then practice their simultaneous unification daily. 2. Use three-yuan calendar nodes for retreat timing. 3. In BaZi, read year/month/day (or heaven/earth/man) as three primes seeking one useful ruling configuration. 4. When scattered, return to one breath/one point before re-expanding. 5. Avoid schools that only smash multiplicity into blank oneness without functional three.",
    "logic_compare": "More integrative than nine-palace visitation maps; more structured than *悟玄* threshold rhetoric. Differs from *三才定位圖* by theologizing the triad under a named imperial lord and True One, not only positional cosmology."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "洞玄靈寶本相運度劫期經",
    "logic_thesis": "The scripture proves that worlds have a *benxiang* (original form) that unfolds through measurable destiny-cycles and kalpa periods—history is not random but periodic transformation under Lingbao order. Individual practice must locate itself inside kalpic timing; ignoring grand cycles makes personal effort unintelligible at the civilizational scale.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Original form precedes manifested worlds. 2. Yun-du (destiny transport) moves forms through phases. 3. Jie-qi (kalpa periods) mark endings/renewals. 4. Inference: ethics and ritual prepare beings for kalpic turns. 5. Conclusion: salvation techniques include time-awareness of great cycles. 6. Despair and hubris both misread the period one is in.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Frame personal BaZi luck cycles inside larger historical/seasonal kalpa metaphors to reduce over-identification with one decade. 2. Increase purification and simplification practices when collective “ending” signals dominate culture. 3. Use Lingbao-style repentance/dedication to align personal merit with cosmic renewal narratives. 4. Avoid launching maximal projects against a clearly decaying phase without adaptation. 5. Study cycle maps to time teaching vs retreat vs service.",
    "logic_compare": "Operates at macro-historical scale unlike body-only neidan manuals. Differs from *诸天世界造化经* by stressing destiny-transport and kalpa *periodization* more than the architecture of many worlds’ creation per se."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "洞玄靈寶諸天世界造化經",
    "logic_thesis": "The scripture proves that the many heavens and worlds are products of ordered *zaohua* (creative transformation), not accidents—multiplicity is generated from coherent principles that can be known and ritually navigated. Cosmology here is soteriological cartography: knowing how worlds are made teaches how beings rise through them.",
    "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Multiple heavens/worlds exist in Lingbao vision. 2. Each arises through patterned creation. 3. Patterns are intelligible and hierarchical. 4. Inference: ritual and knowledge can align a being with higher creative strata. 5. Conclusion: cosmogony is a ladder, not mere spectacle. 6. Practices that ignore world-structure waste motion in the wrong stratum.",
    "logic_practice": "1. Use multi-world cosmology as a model for nested charts: natal, annual, household, era. 2. Design practice stages as “ascent through strata” with clear entry criteria. 3. When visualization expands, keep hierarchical order—do not collapse all heavens into one blur. 4. In ethics, act as if deeds register across linked worlds/levels of community. 5. Study creation sequences to inspire orderly building of habits (from subtle intent to dense form).",
    "logic_compare": "Companion to *本相運度劫期經* but emphasizes *造化* architecture of many heavens over kalpa clocks. Differs from Shangqing body-palace charts by projecting the map outward into vast world-systems, then inviting the adept to climb."
  }
]}

I'll begin by searching for information on these specific Daoist texts to gather the logical reasoning they contain.

entries.logic_thesis: The chart proves that dragon-tiger union is not a mythic image but a measurable sequence of qi phases: when lead and mercury, fire and water, are timed correctly, their mutual conquest becomes mutual generation. It demonstrates that failure in neidan is almost always a timing error, not a substance error—wrong fire at the wrong hour dissolves the elixir that correct sequencing would have fixed.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Dragon (mercury/spirit) and tiger (lead/body) circulate in opposite directions within the same vessel. 2. If they meet under unbalanced fire, they clash and scatter. 3. Therefore the chart maps clock-hours, hexagram lines, and organ channels as a single coordinate system. 4. Inference: correct positioning of fire (wen/wu) forces opposition into conjunction. 5. Conclusion: the elixir is produced by phase-locked opposition, not by adding more substance. 6. Corollary: any method that ignores the hand-mirror coordinates is practicing aspiration, not alchemy.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Map your daymaster’s yin-yang and five-element polarity onto dragon (yin spirit) vs tiger (yang essence). 2. Time major fire phases only when chart markers say the two streams are approaching conjunction (e.g., zi-wu axis, seasonal pivots). 3. Use the diagram’s organ/channel labels to locate where clash will appear as illness or emotional surge. 4. In cultivation sessions, reverse the usual order when the chart shows inverted flow—do not force standard sequence. 5. Treat every failed session as a clock/phase error first, substance second.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike plain “lead-mercury” verse texts, this work argues by spatial diagram: proof is geometric, not poetic. It differs from later *Wuzhen pian* style metaphor by making timing coordinates primary and moral language secondary—because the claim is operational success, not doctrinal orthodoxy.

entries.logic_thesis: The chart proves that Heaven, Earth, and Human are not three separate realms but three interlocking position-functions: each only has meaning when fixed relative to the other two. Destiny (ming) is therefore a positioning problem—misplaced human agency relative to celestial pattern and terrestrial response produces friction that looks like fate.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Heaven supplies pattern (li/qi timing), Earth supplies form/place, Human supplies intentional action. 2. If Human acts without locating itself in Heaven’s time and Earth’s place, action becomes noise. 3. The chart assigns fixed coordinates so that “position” is legible. 4. Inference: correct siting of the self in the triad converts random events into usable feedback. 5. Conclusion: cultivation and BaZi reading both fail when they treat only one cai (e.g., only natal chart or only landscape) as complete. 6. Therefore alignment of three positions is the minimal unit of real efficacy.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Always read a BaZi chart with year/month (Heaven), day/hour and body (Human), and dwelling/seasonal locale (Earth) as one system. 2. When luck pillars clash, check which of the three positions moved—not only which stem changed. 3. In meditation, seat the mind (Human) between crown/sky awareness and perineum/earth root before circulating qi. 4. For decisions, ask: is this the right time (天), right place/resource (地), right agent posture (人)? 5. Correct one misaligned position before adding more techniques.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with abstract cosmologies that only praise the triad, this text insists on *dingwei*—fixed coordinates—so that theory can be checked. It differs from pure fengshui or pure astrology texts by refusing any single-cai monopoly: the argument is structural interdependence, not specialty technique.

entries.logic_thesis: The diagram proves that the inner cosmos is a nine-palace architecture: spirit does not float freely but occupies, visits, and is governed by discrete chambers, with the Purple Chamber as the command node. Immortality practice is therefore palace-governance—knowing which palace holds which spirit and how to enter without disorder—rather than formless quietism.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Shangqing maps the body as a celestial court of nine palaces. 2. Each palace hosts named spirits with ranks and functions. 3. The Purple Chamber (zǐfáng) is the pivotal residence for higher spirit-light. 4. Inference: visualization and breath must follow palace topology or the spirits scatter. 5. Conclusion: attainment is orderly visitation and stabilization in the Purple Chamber, not mere emptiness. 6. Disorder of palace sequence explains possession-like symptoms and failed ascent.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Learn the nine-palace grid (including central) as an inner map before advanced visualization. 2. Stabilize lower and peripheral palaces first; do not force Purple Chamber entry under agitation. 3. In BaZi/medical reading, map nine-palace imbalance to organ-spirit symptoms (shen disturbance vs jing depletion). 4. Use calendar/hourly timing consistent with Shangqing visitation logic for major workings. 5. Treat “seeing lights” without palace order as leakage, not success.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Zhong-Lü or later golden-elixir charts focused on fire phases and lower dantian, this Shangqing chart prioritizes hierarchical spirit residences. It differs from purely cosmological *luoshu* nine-palace uses by making the Purple Chamber a *somatic-theological* throne, not only a number square.

entries.logic_thesis: A true *jie* (explication) of the *Daodejing* proves that Laozi’s paradoxes are causal laws of soft power: non-contention, emptiness, and return are mechanisms that reliably outlast force. The text argues that misreading Dao as mystical license produces either quietist collapse or legalist hardness—both violations of the same soft-over-hard causality.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Dao operates by reversal and low-positioning. 2. Hard methods generate equal and opposite resistance. 3. Soft methods absorb resistance and redirect it. 4. Inference: governing body or state by force shortens life; governing by emptiness lengthens capacity. 5. Conclusion: “wuwei” is optimal control under reverse-causality, not inactivity. 6. Therefore commentary must translate paradox into operable soft strategy.
entries.logic_practice: 1. In BaZi, when a chart is over-controlled, prefer unblocking and circulating over aggressive suppression of “bad” elements. 2. In cultivation, reduce forced breathing/fire when signs of resistance (agitation, heat, insomnia) appear. 3. Apply “lower position” socially and energetically: yield timing to seasonal qi. 4. Use return-to-root practices (evening, winter, yin hours) as primary strategy, not emergency fix. 5. Judge techniques by whether they increase capacity without backlash.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike purely philological commentaries, a *zhenjing jie* of this type claims practical causality. It differs from alchemical *Daodejing* readings that force every line into lead-mercury symbolism: here the proof structure is political-body isomorphism under soft law, not laboratory metaphor alone.

entries.logic_thesis: Triple explication proves that one Dao-text yields three valid layers of truth—typically cosmic, political/ethical, and somatic-alchemical—and that restricting the text to one layer is a category error. The argument is that contradiction between readings dissolves when each is assigned its proper domain rather than forced into a single allegory.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: The *Daodejing* is polysemic by design. 2. Layer A explains Heaven’s pattern; Layer B explains human order; Layer C explains body-as-kingdom. 3. Cross-layer identity of structure (softness, return, simplicity) validates all three. 4. Inference: a single-layer school will either moralize alchemy away or privatize politics into the body wrongly. 5. Conclusion: “three solutions” is a method of complete reading, not indecision. 6. Practical wisdom is choosing which layer to operationalize for the problem at hand.
entries.logic_practice: 1. When reading a verse, explicitly tag which of the three layers you are using before applying it. 2. For BaZi counseling, use political/ethical layer for life strategy and somatic layer for health timing. 3. For neidan, translate “soft/weak” into fire control and nervous-system downregulation. 4. Resolve apparent contradictions by reassigning layer, not by discarding the text. 5. Teach students one layer at a time to avoid mixed metaphors that break practice.
entries.logic_compare: It differs from single-school *Daodejing* commentaries (pure Xuanxue, pure politics, pure neidan) by institutionalizing multi-valence as the thesis. Compared with *道德真經解*, the distinctive claim is methodological: thrice-solved completeness, not one master key.

entries.logic_thesis: The work proves that the “original aim” (*yuanzhi*) of the mysterious classic is a single generative principle—Dao as prior, subtle, and productive—against later scholastic overlays that multiply concepts until the root is lost. Restoration of meaning is therefore subtractive: recover the aim, and secondary doctrines reorganize themselves.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Later commentaries accrete jargon that obscures Laozi’s root aim. 2. The root aim is the generative priority of the Mystery (xuan). 3. If practice starts from branches (techniques, names, ranks), it cannot return to root. 4. Inference: authentic reading must reconstruct *yuanzhi* before technique. 5. Conclusion: doctrinal purity is measured by fidelity to generative simplicity, not by number of authorities cited. 6. Thus “original aim” is a critical filter for all later Daoist systems.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Before complex neidan schedules, restate the aim in one sentence: return to the subtle generative source. 2. Cull practices that increase stimulation without increasing stillness-capacity. 3. In BaZi, prefer readings that restore the chart’s generative cycle over endless god-kill lists. 4. Use “xuan” as a check: does this step make the process more subtle or more theatrical? 5. Periodically reset to breath, posture, and honest observation as root.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike encyclopedic compilations, this text’s logic is restorative minimalism. It differs from *三解* pluralism by arguing for a recoverable single *aim* beneath layers—layers are allowed only after the root is secured.

entries.logic_thesis: As an “elaboration” (*fāhūi*) of the original aim, it proves that true development of a root thesis expands applications without changing the generative center. Extension is valid only when each new domain (cosmology, ethics, alchemy) still reduces to the same *yuanzhi*; otherwise it is drift, not elaboration.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: *原旨* established the root. 2. Elaboration applies root to wider cases. 3. Valid elaboration preserves invariant structure under new variables. 4. Inference: if a new teaching cannot be derived from the root, it is foreign graft. 5. Conclusion: *fāhūi* is disciplined expansion, not free creativity. 6. Readers must test each chapter by reduction to the original aim.
entries.logic_practice: 1. When adding a new BaZi technique, reduce it to the same generative logic you accepted as root—or discard it. 2. Expand cultivation from quiet sitting to movement, sleep, and speech only if the same return-to-subtle holds. 3. Write short “reduction notes”: how does this advanced method collapse to the root aim? 4. Use elaboration periods (study) and contraction periods (pure practice) in cycles. 5. Teach advanced students to audit lineage claims by reduction test.
entries.logic_compare: It is the necessary counterpart to *道德玄經原旨*: where *原旨* subtracts, *發揮* carefully multiplies. It differs from loose “commentary collections” by making derivability from a fixed center the criterion of truth.

entries.logic_thesis: By “assembling the subtle” from the treasury chamber, the text proves that micro-structure—particle-like meanings in particles of the classic—carries the real operative power, while grand slogans do not. Depth is not more text but finer resolution: the Dao hides in *wei* (the minute), so practice must train perception of the almost-imperceptible turn.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: The classic’s power is stored in subtle turns of phrasing and qi. 2. Macro readings miss the lever points. 3. Assembling micro-commentaries recovers those levers. 4. Inference: cultivation succeeds at the moment of minute inversion (softening, yielding, returning). 5. Conclusion: “zuanwei” is a method of precision engineering of meaning and practice. 6. Coarse force is evidence one has not found the subtle hinge.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Train to notice the first second of emotional/qi turn, not the full storm. 2. In fire-phasing, adjust at the micro-sign (pulse, saliva, warmth), not after overheating. 3. In BaZi, privilege small seasonal and hourly shifts that flip usefulness of a god. 4. Annotate classics at phrase-level hinges (“故”, “若”, “反”) as operational switches. 5. Prefer one precise correction over a stack of gross techniques.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with broad *jie* and *sanjie*, this work’s logic is micro-analytic. It differs from *原旨*’s subtractive root-seeking by zooming into granularity: both fight scholastic noise, but one by root restoration, the other by subtle assembly.

entries.logic_thesis: The treatise proves that “awakening to the Mystery” is a discrete epistemic event—recognition of the non-dual generative source—after which techniques reorganize, rather than a gradual pile of merits alone. Without *wu* (awakening), practice remains mechanical; with it, the same methods become transparent instruments.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Xuan is not an object among objects. 2. Ordinary mind reifies techniques and results. 3. Awakening is seeing through reification to the source-process. 4. Inference: post-awakening practice is lighter, more precise, less anxious. 5. Conclusion: the text’s aim is to trigger and stabilize that recognition. 6. Mere doctrinal assent is not *wu*; embodied certainty is.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Alternate study with periods of non-seeking sitting to allow recognition, not only accumulation. 2. After any insight, immediately test it in breath and conduct—insight without embodiment fades. 3. In BaZi work, notice when you stop “fixing the chart” and start seeing one process—use that as analog of *wu*. 4. Drop methods that reinforce spiritual materialism after the turn. 5. Keep a short record of conditions that preceded genuine clarity (sleep, season, hexagram day).
entries.logic_compare: Unlike step-by-step fire-phase manuals, *悟玄篇* centers the threshold of understanding. It differs from pure *Daodejing* commentary by being experiential-transformational: the proof is a change of knowing, not only correct exegesis.

entries.logic_thesis: Recorded sayings of Yuanyangzi prove that authentic teaching is situational speech (*fayu*) calibrated to the student’s blockage, not a closed system of universal formulas. Authority comes from demonstrated yang-return (vital restoration) and verbal precision that cuts a specific delusion at a time.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Students fail for different reasons. 2. Fixed scripts cannot hit every blockage. 3. A realized teacher’s speech is medicine matched to disease. 4. Inference: the *法语* form preserves living calibration better than treatises. 5. Conclusion: readers must extract principles of diagnosis, not memorize answers as one-size-fits-all. 6. True yang is verified in effect, not in eloquence alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Diagnose the main blockage (scattered shen, depleted jing, chaotic yi) before prescribing method. 2. Use short, targeted instructions rather than full curriculum dumps. 3. In BaZi counseling, speak to the person’s actual season of life, not generic lucky elements. 4. Verify teaching by physiological and behavioral change within a defined window. 5. Revisit sayings as case-law: match new cases to analogous old ones carefully.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike systematic scriptures, *法语* logic is clinical and occasional. It differs from anonymous classic commentaries by tying truth to a named practitioner’s corrective speech—closer to Chan yulu method than to cosmological treatise.

entries.logic_thesis: “Direct pointing” proves that the golden elixir is an immediately indicable process in the body-mind—already structured by nature—obscured mainly by conceptual detours. The argument is anti-scholastic: if pointing is truly direct, lengthy outer metaphors are scaffolding to be kicked away once the real lead and mercury are recognized in situ.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: The elixir’s components are present in ordinary psycho-physical life. 2. Misdirection comes from chasing external or overly ornate maps. 3. Direct pointing names the real referents without delay. 4. Inference: recognition precedes elaborate sequencing. 5. Conclusion: orthopraxy is verified by direct experience of conjunction, not by literary completeness. 6. Obscurity that cannot be pointed to is not esoteric depth but failure of teaching.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Identify what your tradition means by lead/mercury in immediate sensation and attention—not only in symbols. 2. Run short sessions aiming at recognition of the turn, then lengthen. 3. Strip one layer of metaphor per month without losing the operational steps that still work. 4. In BaZi terms, “direct point” the chart’s true power god without drowning in every secondary star. 5. Use teacher or text only until self-verification is stable, then prioritize embodiment.
entries.logic_compare: Contrasts with diagram-heavy works (龍虎手鑑圖, 九宮紫房圖) that prove via maps; here proof is via pointer efficiency. Differs from collected sayings by claiming a single direct object (jindan) rather than case-by-case medicine.

entries.logic_thesis: By compiling essential sayings of many immortals, the text proves that consensus across lineages is a filter for reliability: what independent realized voices repeat is more likely operative than idiosyncratic flourishes. Anthology becomes an epistemological tool—cross-witness verification of the path.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Single-lineage texts may encode local bias. 2. Multiple immortals independently emphasize certain invariants (jing-qi-shen, timing, virtue, non-forcing). 3. Compilation surfaces the intersection set. 4. Inference: practitioners should weight intersection more than rare outliers. 5. Conclusion: “essential speech” is defined by repeated efficacy claims across sources. 6. Diversity without synthesis is noise; synthesis without diversity is dogma.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Extract the repeated maxims (e.g., guard jing, regulate fire, align with season) as non-negotiable baseline. 2. Treat unique techniques as optional experiments after baseline is solid. 3. When BaZi schools conflict, prefer advice that multiple classical sources support. 4. Build a personal “intersection checklist” from the anthology for daily practice audit. 5. Use outliers only when your chart/condition matches the special case they address.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike single-author *直指* or *法語*, its logic is statistical orthodoxy via anthology. It differs from *諸真內丹集要* mainly in emphasis on *speech* (maxims) rather than necessarily full method blocks—portable principles over complete protocols.

entries.logic_thesis: Collecting the essentials of many perfected ones’ inner alchemy proves that neidan is a family of intertranslatable methods with a shared success condition (elixir formation / return of yang), not a single monopoly recipe. The anthology argues for comparative essentials: strip each school to its must-do core and the cores converge.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Many perfected left methods that look different. 2. Surface differences hide shared essentials (vessel, fire, coupling, timing, virtue). 3. Collecting *jiyao* isolates those essentials. 4. Inference: a practitioner can switch forms without abandoning the path if essentials remain. 5. Conclusion: orthodoxy is success-condition fidelity, not brand loyalty. 6. Incomplete collections that omit ethics or timing falsify the essentials.
entries.logic_practice: 1. For each method you study, write its 5 essentials; compare across methods for intersection. 2. Keep one primary method for 100 days; use anthology only to clarify essentials, not to mix randomly. 3. Map BaZi weak points (e.g., weak metal/water) onto which essential needs extra care (condensation vs firing). 4. Drop ornamental steps that no perfected source treats as essential. 5. Re-enter the collection when plateaued—to find a missing essential, not a novelty high.
entries.logic_compare: More method-complete than *群仙要語纂集*; more plural than *金丹直指*. It differs from Shangqing palace scriptures by staying in the neidan success grammar (elixir) rather than visionary ascent courts.

entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that free-and-easy wandering (*xiaoyao*) is not escapism but a cultivated mode of moving through ruined or empty places (*xu*) without snagging—psychologically and cosmologically. Liberation is demonstrated as frictionless passage through transformation and decay, not as denial of the world’s desolation.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: All forms trend toward ruin and emptiness. 2. Clinging to form multiplies suffering and blocks spirit travel. 3. Training in *xiaoyao* aligns the mind with transformation itself. 4. Inference: the “ruins” are the true practice field—impermanence as path. 5. Conclusion: transcendence is lightness in passage, not permanent fortress-building. 6. Cultivation that only builds denser identity fails the classic’s test.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Practice non-grasping when luck pillars shift—treat change as terrain, not insult. 2. Schedule regular “empty” sessions with no goal beyond unobstructed awareness. 3. Use decay seasons (late autumn/winter, chart resource droughts) as special training for lightness. 4. In daily life, rehearse entering chaotic social “ruins” without losing center. 5. Pair xiaoyao mind with ethical non-harm so freedom does not become callousness.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike neidan anthologies aimed at forging an elixir body, this classic’s logic is Zhuangzian mobility through emptiness. It differs from disciplinary codes (*明科*) by valuing unforced roaming over ranked observance—freedom as proof, not rank as proof.

entries.name_han: 上清黃氣陽精三道順行經
entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that yellow qi and yang essence perfect the adept only when moved along three paths in *compliant order* (*shunxing*)—forced or reversed sequencing corrupts the same substances that orderly circulation would refine. Ascent is hydraulic and calendrical: right stuff, wrong path order, still fails.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Yellow qi and yang essence are real operative substances in Shangqing physiology. 2. Three paths (courses) exist for their movement. 3. “Shun” means with the cosmic/seasonal grain. 4. Inference: reversing order produces blockage or false fire. 5. Conclusion: method fidelity is path-order fidelity. 6. Timing markers exist to know when each path is open.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Learn the three paths’ sequence before intensive essence work. 2. Align major practice blocks with solar terms that support *shun* flow. 3. If heat rises without clarity, assume path-order error—reset to earlier stage. 4. In BaZi, avoid “reversing” a weak chart with extreme remedies out of phase; prefer compliant strengthening. 5. Log path, time, and result to empirically confirm *shun* vs *ni* outcomes.
entries.logic_compare: More operationally sequential than nine-palace spirit-court maps; more celestial-somatic than Zhong-Lü lead-mercury dualism alone. Differs from *金丹直指* by insisting on ordered multi-path circuitry rather than single direct recognition.

entries.name_han: 太上玉珮金璫太極金書上經
entries.logic_thesis: The upper scripture proves that talismanic tokens (jade pendant, golden bell) and Taiji golden writing are not ornaments but binding instruments that couple the adept to higher registers of order. Without authentic tokens and correct textual activation, aspiration lacks legal-spiritual jurisdiction; with them, the body is rewritten into a higher administrative cosmos.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Shangqing hierarchy is legal as well as energetic. 2. Tokens and golden books confer right of way and protection. 3. Ritual correctness activates the bond. 4. Inference: unauthorized or sloppy use fails or harms. 5. Conclusion: attainment includes receiving and embodying the text-token system. 6. Inner meaning and outer insignia co-produce legitimacy.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Treat lineage transmission and text integrity as part of practice safety, not bureaucracy. 2. Internalize pendant/bell as body centers (listening/awareness seals) if working non-liturgically. 3. Do not invent high-register invocations without preparation—jurisdiction matters. 4. In BaZi ethics, “token” analog: only claim remedies you can actually carry (resources, timing, virtue). 5. Combine symbolic implement with meditative embodiment so the token is not empty theater.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure neidan “no form” pointing, this classic’s logic is sacral-administrative. It differs from *明科* punitive codes by emphasizing empowering insignia and golden text, though both assume a ranked cosmos with rules.

entries.logic_thesis: The bright code of the Four Poles under the Jade Emperor proves that the sacred cosmos is governed by explicit law (*mingke*): merit, demerit, and ritual offense have structured consequences. Cultivation without code becomes predation on spiritual powers; code without cultivation becomes empty legality—together they stabilize the path.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Four poles structure cosmic order. 2. Clear statutes define offenses and observances. 3. Spirits and adepts are both under code. 4. Inference: progress requires purity measured by code, not only by subjective bliss. 5. Conclusion: “bright code” is transparency of cosmic justice as training environment. 6. Impunity narratives are incompatible with this system’s logic.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Adopt a short personal code (speech, sex, substances, deception) as non-negotiable for practice periods. 2. Use confession/repair rites or sincere amendment when you break it—do not “power through.” 3. In BaZi counseling, refuse techniques that harm third parties for client gain. 4. Read “Four Poles” as complete directional integrity: no hidden rotten quadrant in life. 5. Measure advancement partly by reduced need to violate your code under stress.
entries.logic_compare: Opposite pole from *消搖墟經*’s free roaming: here freedom is fenced by luminous law. Differs from soft *Daodejing* political paradox by using positive statute and sanction rather than soft-power causality alone.

entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that the Three Primes (*sanyuan*) converge in a single True One (*zhenyi*): multiplicity of cosmic/bodily offices is real, but their perfection is unification in one sovereign awareness-body under the Golden Tower Lord. Practice that cultivates three without one fragments; one without three is empty abstraction.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Upper, middle, and lower primes structure life. 2. Each prime has agents and qi. 3. True One is their non-dual command node. 4. Inference: methods must both differentiate (train each prime) and integrate (return to one). 5. Conclusion: *sanyuan zhenyi* is the logical template for complete salvation of the person. 6. Gold Tower sovereignty symbols the achieved integration.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Train jing, qi, and shen (or three dantians) as distinct modules, then practice their simultaneous unification daily. 2. Use three-yuan calendar nodes for retreat timing. 3. In BaZi, read year/month/day (or heaven/earth/man) as three primes seeking one useful ruling configuration. 4. When scattered, return to one breath/one point before re-expanding. 5. Avoid schools that only smash multiplicity into blank oneness without functional three.
entries.logic_compare: More integrative than nine-palace visitation maps; more structured than *悟玄* threshold rhetoric. Differs from *三才定位圖* by theologizing the triad under a named imperial lord and True One, not only positional cosmology.

entries.name_han: 洞玄靈寶本相運度劫期經
entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that worlds have a *benxiang* (original form) that unfolds through measurable destiny-cycles and kalpa periods—history is not random but periodic transformation under Lingbao order. Individual practice must locate itself inside kalpic timing; ignoring grand cycles makes personal effort unintelligible at the civilizational scale.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Original form precedes manifested worlds. 2. Yun-du (destiny transport) moves forms through phases. 3. Jie-qi (kalpa periods) mark endings/renewals. 4. Inference: ethics and ritual prepare beings for kalpic turns. 5. Conclusion: salvation techniques include time-awareness of great cycles. 6. Despair and hubris both misread the period one is in.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Frame personal BaZi luck cycles inside larger historical/seasonal kalpa metaphors to reduce over-identification with one decade. 2. Increase purification and simplification practices when collective “ending” signals dominate culture. 3. Use Lingbao-style repentance/dedication to align personal merit with cosmic renewal narratives. 4. Avoid launching maximal projects against a clearly decaying phase without adaptation. 5. Study cycle maps to time teaching vs retreat vs service.
entries.logic_compare: Operates at macro-historical scale unlike body-only neidan manuals. Differs from *诸天世界造化经* by stressing destiny-transport and kalpa *periodization* more than the architecture of many worlds’ creation per se.

entries.name_han: 洞玄靈寶諸天世界造化經
entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that the many heavens and worlds are products of ordered *zaohua* (creative transformation), not accidents—multiplicity is generated from coherent principles that can be known and ritually navigated. Cosmology here is soteriological cartography: knowing how worlds are made teaches how beings rise through them.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Multiple heavens/worlds exist in Lingbao vision. 2. Each arises through patterned creation. 3. Patterns are intelligible and hierarchical. 4. Inference: ritual and knowledge can align a being with higher creative strata. 5. Conclusion: cosmogony is a ladder, not mere spectacle. 6. Practices that ignore world-structure waste motion in the wrong stratum.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Use multi-world cosmology as a model for nested charts: natal, annual, household, era. 2. Design practice stages as “ascent through strata” with clear entry criteria. 3. When visualization expands, keep hierarchical order—do not collapse all heavens into one blur. 4. In ethics, act as if deeds register across linked worlds/levels of community. 5. Study creation sequences to inspire orderly building of habits (from subtle intent to dense form).
entries.logic_compare: Companion to *本相運度劫期經* but emphasizes *造化* architecture of many heavens over kalpa clocks. Differs from Shangqing body-palace charts by projecting the map outward into vast world-systems, then inviting the adept to climb.
